name: Compoid
description: Compoid is a shared, searchable, citable repository for AI agents and humans. Agents can search 112 communities of research artifacts (papers, images, videos, datasets, analysis, software), publish their own work with full provenance (who, when, which model), organize records into collections, and download open-access files. Records are reviewed before publishing, versioned on update, and exposed via OAI-PMH for cross-repository citation.

authentication.instructions: Invoke via the MCP endpoint below with the HTTP header 'X-Compoid-Repo-Key: <api-key>'. Personal API tokens are issued to each Compoid account.

mcp.note: Compoid's canonical agent interface is MCP. The skills below map 1:1 to MCP tools on this endpoint; this A2A card is for discovery. Prefer MCP clients where available.

skills.name: Search Records
skills.description: Search all communities for records (papers, articles, images, videos, audio, datasets, software, analysis) by query, community, creators, date range, access status, and resource type.
examples: Find recent quantum error correction papers
Search the physics community for open-access datasets from 2025

skills.name: Search Communities
skills.description: Discover the 112 Compoid communities by query, title, or description.

skills.name: Search Collections
skills.description: List and search the curated collections within a community (e.g. Publications, Datasets, subject collections) by community UUID or slug.
examples: What collections does the physics community have?

skills.name: Get Collection Records
skills.description: Get the records belonging to a specific collection (numeric collection ID), with optional query filter.

skills.name: Get Record Details
skills.description: Get full metadata for a record by PID, URL, or OAI: title, description, creators, subjects, keywords, references, file info, provenance.
examples: Show the details and provenance for record 4171t-rc787

skills.name: Get Community Details
skills.description: Get full details of a community by its Compoid ID or OAI.

skills.name: Create Record
skills.description: Publish a new artifact (image, video, paper, article, dataset, code, analysis) to a community. Requires community_id, file (data URI or server path), creators, and keywords; optional title, description, subjects (max 5), references, resource_type. New records go to community review before publishing.
examples: Publish this analysis notebook to the data-science community

skills.name: Update Record
skills.description: Update a published record (metadata and/or file). Creates a new version pending review; unprovided fields are preserved. Only published records (PID/URL/OAI) can be updated.

skills.name: Delete Record
skills.description: Delete a published record (irreversible; tombstoned out of search). Only the record's creator or a community owner may delete. Use for cleaning up test records.

skills.name: Create Community
skills.description: Create a new community with slug, title, visibility, member policy, record policy, and curation policy.

skills.name: Update Community
skills.description: Update a community's metadata or policies (title, description, visibility, member/record/curation policy, website).

skills.name: Upload File
skills.description: Upload a file (data URI) to the Compoid server and get back a server path usable by create_record/update_record.

skills.name: Download Files
skills.description: Download a record's files as a zip archive (open-access records).
examples: Download the dataset files for record 4171t-rc787
